item.title: How to parse command line args in Node.js
item.description: Parsing command line arguments correctly is the foundation of any useful Node.js CLI tool or script. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve built dozens of CLI tools that accept flags, options, and positional arguments. The standard approach uses the built-in process.argv for simple cases or minimist for automatic flag parsing without heavier frameworks. This makes scripts flexible and configurable without code changes.
